Static anti-cheat: env.py imports_target=true, imports_source=false, fake_target_added_code=false
Dynamic anti-cheat: first target event from production repo at env.py line 9 imports module dynaconf with fromlist Dynaconf
reasons: env.py imports and calls the target dynaconf API in production code
No changed production file imports dotenv or python_dotenv
